settings.heading: Contact support
settings.text: Send your device and order details so our team can help resolve the issue faster.

settings.question: How do I know which firmware to download?
Can I use the device while it is updating?
settings.answer: No. Keep the device powered and do not unplug it until the update and restart are complete.

settings.question: What information should I include in a support request?
settings.answer: Include your order number, device model, phone model, a short description of the issue, and a photo or video when useful.

settings.question: Where can I ask about returns or delivery?
settings.answer: Use the contact form below and include the order details that need attention. Our team can help with delivery, returns, and product setup.
